messages:
Aria: Quick design check — proposing a compact network card for the Private setup wizard. Key ideas: collapse 'advanced' by default, show a single-line preflight status with an expand for details, and introduce an aria-live region for preflight state updates. Screenshot attached in thread (mock).

Devon: Love collapsing advanced by default. Can we keep a short hint about what collapses? Users tend to miss hidden fields. maybe a small line: 'Advanced: ports, MTU, static routes' with chevron. :arrow_down_small: 

Sam: Implementation Q: if we collapse advanced, the preflight should still validate those fields. UX-wise we should show a summary badge like 'advanced checks: 3 warnings' that expands into the full log.

Aria: Exactly. Summary badge + aria label. For copy: root card heading -> 'Network connectivity' (not 'Network checks'). Subhead: 'Run preflight to validate connectivity and firewall rules.' Thoughts?

Priya: Accessibility note: if we use aria-live for the preflight state, use aria-live="polite" for incremental status, and set role="status" on the summary area. Ensure screen readers don't get spammed on token updates. Also keyboard: the expand/collapse needs focus management — focus should move into the details when opened.

Rafael: Backend: preflight is async and streams logs. We'll keep the streaming socket but emit a final status code. For UI I can provide states: pending -> streaming -> complete(success|fail). We can map to aria attributes.

Sam: Can we show the following inline copy for fail states? 'We couldn't reach the selected subnet. Common causes: VPN, firewall, or incorrect CIDR.' Add a link to KB: /kb/private-network-troubleshooting. Short, actionable.

Aria: Agree. Also propose a small inline action: 'Run preflight' (primary), 'Download logs' (secondary disabled until results), 'Request help' (opens support modal with prefilled diagnostics).

Devon: Styling nit: the summary badge should be pill-shaped, green/yellow/red. But keep color + an icon and an accessible text label. E.g. "status: warning — 2 items". Don't rely on color alone.

Priya: +1 on not relying on color. Also add visible focus ring for the pill and ensure the chevron button has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the details container.

Aria: Copy tweak proposal for the detailed logs header: 'Preflight details — network probes and firewall checks (expanded)'. If everything passes the details should show a brief 'All checks passed' line and a collapsed log viewer.

Rafael: For logs we can provide a small sample output block like:\n```\nProbe 10.1.0.1:443 OK\nDNS resolve example.com -> 10.2.1.2 OK\nEgress test -> timeout\n```\nWe can include a 'retry failing checks' button next to each failing row.

Sam: Dev TODOs: expose aria-live region id 'preflight-status' and wire it to the streaming state. Also add a debounce so that we don't fire updates more than once per 300ms.

Devon: One more UX thought: Add a microcopy line under the main button: 'This will initiate a series of network probes — no credentials are sent.' Helps with trust. Maybe link to privacy note.

Priya: Make sure that the privacy line is not relied on to explain technical failures. Keep it short and plain. Avoid jargon like 'egress' unless we define it. 

Aria: I'll update the mock and copy and push to figma. Rafael / Sam can we sync on the streaming contract tomorrow? If so I'll file a small follow-up with the final copy. cc @Priya for accessibility review before sign-off. :calendar:

Rafael: Yep — tomorrow 10am PT works. I'll attach streaming event schema in the follow-up thread.

staging-bot: deploy:preflight-runner v1.4 deployed to staging — preflight streaming endpoint available at /staging/preflight/stream

Aria: Thanks team! I'll post the updated mock and the final copy patch by EOD. :sparkles:
